'''Vacupumps''' were technology manufactured by [[HarborVacc]]. The [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Salishh Tilloman]] sold several thousand vacupumps to finance his way off [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]]. The catch was that he did not actually own any vacupumps, and the deception was Tilloman's first step into a career as a [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]].
